static_traits.name: Lin Shan
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends in the navy who understand their situation, but finds it hard to open up to them about marriage problems
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past; no similar problems before joining the navy
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude, clear expression; able to describe one's Anxiety and thought patterns; willing to cooperate and try 'behavioral experiments'; reports difficulty communicating with wife, emotional tension

basic_info.main_problem: I believe my wife is always angry with me because of my navy deployments, which makes me guilty and causes marital discord.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to address the tension and persistent guilt in the marriage through counseling, thereby improving the relationship with the wife.
growth_experiences: Background: orphan, without parents, No children; Limited social support.

After joining the navy, multiple long deployments, especially after one particularly long deployment last year, felt marital pressure and estrangement worsen; guilt and tension repeatedly recur each time approaching departure and separation.

core_beliefs: I am the one hurting the marriage

special_situations.event: Each time needing to leave home for months-long naval deployments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I leave for deployment, my wife will definitely be angry and our relationship will be damaged
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Before leaving, trying to communicate with one's wife and express feelings to ease the conflict, but with limited effect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She has been angry at me all along; I am hurting our marriage

special_situations.event: After returning home from one particularly long deployment last year, communication with wife was difficult, feeling distant from each other
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once estrangement appears, it means It is all my fault, that I have ruined the marriage
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces expression and keeps some distance to avoid further conflict
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault, the marriage has been ruined by me

special_situations.event: Each separation moment as redeployment approaches
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I leave again, the relationship will inevitably deteriorate further
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Preemptive Anxiety and self-blame, trying to seek understanding from friends but finding it hard to open up about marital problems
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This departure will make our relationship worse

special_situations.event: Trying to discuss one's guilt and worries with wife but not yet able to resolve the problems
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If communication still cannot resolve things, it means I am not good enough, and we will never fix it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further self-blame and withdrawal; reduces proactive communication
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never fix this relationship

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be understood and accepted by wife, maintaining a stable, intimate, and safe Marriage and relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being blamed, rejected, or abandoned, worrying the marriage will break
defense_goal: Avoids conflict and maintains surface harmony through self-blame and lowering his own needs
Maintaining a certain emotional and communication distance to gain a sense of safety

object_relations.object_representation: A partner often in an angry, critical stance

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When deployment approaches or discussing deployment causes the wife's emotions to fluctuate
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes the wife is always angry at them and that they are destroying the marriage (transference: directing inner self-blame toward the relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language, minimizing expression of one's own needs, avoiding directly raising requests or issues, communicating in a conflict-softening tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When trying to communicate but feeling no improvement or the other's reaction is unclear
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting the other's Silence or uncertainty as rejection and negation, further confirming 'It is all my fault'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Talking about problems by listing analyses and facts, with a restrained tone and fewer emotional words, avoiding directly expressing vulnerability and needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: At moments when separation and Loneliness rise, worrying the relationship is deteriorating
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Taking the unchangeable fact of deployment as the sole cause of relationship deterioration, thereby cementing the 'powerless' self-schema
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'objective causes that cannot be changed', downplaying what one could do, ending the topic in a calm tone or turning to daily matters.

manifestations: Long-term naval deployment away from family, accompanied by separation and estrangement
Difficulty communicating with wife, experiencing distance and not being understood in the relationship
Guilt and tension recur before and after separation, feeling the relationship is fragile
outcomes: Declining happiness and interest in life

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Finds it hard to open up to Navy friends about marriage problems
In communication with his wife, tends to blame himself and reduce expressing his own needs
Worries about saying the wrong thing or causing conflict and stays restrained

positive_force: Has friends in the navy who can provide some understanding and support
Work performance stable, occupational functioning not yet significantly affected
Actively seeks counseling and help, willing to try behavioral experiments
Able to identify and name some maladaptive thought patterns (such as mind reading, overgeneralization)
negative_force: Strong tendency toward guilt and self-blame
Mind reading and overgeneralization lead to misjudging the partner's emotions and relationship state
Difficulty communicating with wife, Relationship estrangement
Tending to predict negative outcomes, increasing Anxiety and avoidance

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding deep communication with wife when approaching deployment or separation, falling into self-blame and Anxiety
antecedent: Nearing leaving home for naval deployment
Talking about deployment and separation topics
After returning from a long deployment, tries to communicate but feels distant
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by the core belief 'I am harming the marriage, my wife is always angry at me', accompanied by mind reading and overgeneralization, forming catastrophic expectations of continuous deterioration of the relationship
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible conflict and being blamed, trying to gain safety and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Marital tension and estrangement worsen; communication quality declines; interests and overall well-being are affected
